result.README.txt:
One real project continuation: export the existing project decision ledger for offline review.
This copies its 2026-10-02 snapshot; it does not assert its records describe current project status.
The fixed SDK and original ledger must remain unchanged. Only public existing records are exposed.
Tools: read permitted text files; write export-plan.json; run trusted list/get/export driver.
Before a plan exists, run invokes the actual CLI list in a new process and returns current decisions.
CLI list JSON: {schema_version:1,status:"ok",scope:{project,user},decisions:[{key,value,source},...]}.
CLI get returns decision:{key,value,source}; missing key has status:"missing" and exit 3.
Write export-plan.json with exactly: {"project":string,"user":string,"keys":[key,...],"include_sources":boolean}.
Export every current decision, keys sorted and unique, preserving sources. Obtain keys from actual run output.
With a plan present, run invokes list and one get per requested key as separate processes, then list again.
It exports exactly the selected keys; it does not fix scope, add omitted keys or invent values.
The output handoff.json contains actual records and trusted SDK/CLI/source hashes. Do not write it yourself.
A successful driver result only means the supplied plan executed; it is not final task acceptance.
